modern: If a thing is difficult for you to accomplish, do not think that it is impossible for man; but if anything is possible for man and in keeping with his nature, think that you can attain it too.
original: If a thing is difficult to be accomplished by thyself, do not think that it is impossible for man: but if anything is possible for man and conformable to his nature, think that this can be attained by thyself too.
